facts.fact: Banking consultant Mostefa Zerouali says Bank of Algeria Regulation 25-02 sets the conditions for licensing payment service providers, that the Bank of Algeria is the licensing authority, and that none is yet licensed with several applications under examination.
Zerouali says Law 23-09 and Bank of Algeria Regulations 24-01, 24-04 and 25-02 set conditions for payment service providers, including protection of users and depositors.
